options.name: description
options.description: Description of the firewall rule.

options.name: destinations
options.description: Destination traffic criteria. Each source or destination bloc is capped separately per rule at 100 total segment values. The count is segments_values_count the sum of all values across every segment type in that bloc. Ports use a separate cap of 100.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the rule is enabled.

options.name: meraki_action_batch_retry_wait_time
options.displayName: Meraki Action Batch Retry Wait Time
options.description: meraki_action_batch_retry_wait_time (integer), action batch concurrency error retry wait time

options.name: meraki_api_key
options.description: meraki_api_key (string), API key generated in dashboard; can also be set as an environment variable MERAKI_DASHBOARD_API_KEY

options.name: meraki_base_url
options.description: meraki_base_url (string), preceding all endpoint resources

options.name: meraki_be_geo_id
options.description: meraki_be_geo_id (string), optional partner identifier for API usage tracking; can also be set as an environment variable BE_GEO_ID

options.name: meraki_certificate_path
options.description: meraki_certificate_path (string), path for TLS/SSL certificate verification if behind local proxy

options.name: meraki_inherit_logging_config
options.description: meraki_inherit_logging_config (boolean), Inherits your own logger instance

options.name: meraki_log_file_prefix
options.description: meraki_log_file_prefix (string), log file name appended with date and timestamp

options.name: meraki_log_path
options.description: log_path (string), path to output log; by default, working directory of script if not specified

options.name: meraki_maximum_retries
options.description: meraki_maximum_retries (integer), retry up to this many times when encountering 429s or other server-side errors

options.name: meraki_nginx_429_retry_wait_time
options.description: meraki_nginx_429_retry_wait_time (integer), Nginx 429 retry wait time

options.name: meraki_output_log
options.description: meraki_output_log (boolean), create an output log file?

options.name: meraki_print_console
options.description: meraki_print_console (boolean), print logging output to console?

options.name: meraki_requests_proxy
options.description: meraki_requests_proxy (string), proxy server and port, if needed, for HTTPS

options.name: meraki_retry_4xx_error
options.description: meraki_retry_4xx_error (boolean), retry if encountering other 4XX error (besides 429)?

options.name: meraki_retry_4xx_error_wait_time
options.description: meraki_retry_4xx_error_wait_time (integer), other 4XX error retry wait time

options.name: meraki_simulate
options.description: meraki_simulate (boolean), simulate POST/PUT/DELETE calls to prevent changes?

options.name: meraki_single_request_timeout
options.description: meraki_single_request_timeout (integer), maximum number of seconds for each API call

options.name: meraki_suppress_logging
options.description: meraki_suppress_logging (boolean), disable all logging? you're on your own then!

options.name: meraki_use_iterator_for_get_pages
options.displayName: Meraki Use Iterator For Get Pages
options.description: meraki_use_iterator_for_get_pages (boolean), list* methods will return an iterator with each object instead of a complete list with all items

options.name: meraki_wait_on_rate_limit
options.description: meraki_wait_on_rate_limit (boolean), retry if 429 rate limit error encountered?

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the firewall rule.

options.name: organizationId
options.description: OrganizationId path parameter. Organization ID.

options.name: policy
options.description: Rule policy - allow or deny traffic.

options.name: priority
options.description: Rule priority (lower numbers = higher priority).

options.name: ruleId
options.description: RuleId path parameter. Rule ID.

options.name: rulesetId
options.description: Firewall ruleset ID to associate the rule with.

options.name: sources
options.description: Source traffic criteria. Each source or destination bloc is capped separately per rule at 100 total segment values. The count is segments_values_count the sum of all values across every segment type in that bloc. Ports use a separate cap of 100.
